university: CUNY Graduate School and University Center
notes: The CUNY Graduate School and University Center (the Graduate Center) is a graduate-only institution: it offers doctoral and master's degrees and no bachelor's program, so it has no BS/BA in Computer Science and no CS1/CS2/algorithms/software-engineering frame courses. Its PhD in Computer Science is a graduate degree and outside the undergraduate frame in v2/COURSE_COLLECT.md section 1. Per that rule, program is null and collection stops.
